capture.scope: Every tracked regular file, retaining nested packages, tests, documentation, data and dotfiles. All 32 pinned trees contain only regular blobs. Upstream code is never run.
capture.reference: Assigned overall duplicated_lines_density GT 3; analysis ID, CE task, component measures and per-file duplication locations from the same completed Community scan.
capture.comparison: Densities round to one decimal. Exact lines are inclusive intervals, keyed by repository-relative paths. Only concrete frozen residuals may remain; improvements are accepted. This reference does not measure individual rule findings or new-code periods.
capture.measures: api/measures/component and api/measures/component_tree (all FIL pages); api/sources/lines duplicated flags checked against each file count, with api/duplications/show groups retained separately; api/qualitygates/project_status by analysis ID. File endpoints are bound to the sole completed analysis and revision before and after collection.
capture.integrity: tracked.sha256 is SHA-256 of compact sorted JSON mapping every exact Git path to its SHA-256 content digest; commit and tree additionally bind object IDs and modes. Capture digests cover the decompressed recorded JSON responses.
